Questions

What is ontap?

ontap is a beer tracker and beer log for iPhone. Tap once to log a beer and where you are, keep a diary of every pint, and get your stats and a recap every month.

Is ontap free?

Yes. ontap is free to download and use on iPhone.

Who can see where I am?

Only friends you've added see where you've logged a beer. You can turn off location sharing at any time in the app, and you only appear on the Global tab if you choose to.

Can I use it with my friends?

Yes. Add friends to see who's out, tag them in your taps and start a squad to race each other each week or month.

How do I become Mayor of a bar?

Log the most beers at a spot over the last 60 days, across at least two nights, and you're its Mayor until someone takes it.
